name: get_service_order_status
description: Retrieve the authorised status of a service order from ServiceIQ.

inputs.name: order_number
inputs.info: The human-readable service order number to look up. Example: ORD-2024-001.

inputs.name: api_base_url
inputs.info: Base URL of the ServiceIQ AI API.

inputs.name: bearer_token
inputs.info: JWT Bearer token. Must be stored in the Langflow secret store.

security_notes: The bearer_token field uses SecretStrInput and is never stored in flow JSON.
The component never accesses the database directly.
The order_number is the only value taken from LLM/flow context.
Server-side authorisation is enforced by the backend; this component does not bypass it.
All errors are returned as structured Data objects — no raw exceptions reach the LLM.
